title: Implement Stale Policy Profiles by Ticket Criticality
description: Introduce configurable stale-handling policy profiles by ticket type/criticality (`strict` and `permissive`) and ensure policy decisions are transparent in claim metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Given policy configuration, when claim evaluates stale packet, then response behavior matches profile.
Given strict profile ticket, when packet is stale or missing, then claim response clearly indicates non-fresh execution restriction.
Given permissive profile ticket, when packet is stale, then response includes stale metadata and background recompile request.
Given policy tests, when run, then backend/security/infra defaults align with architecture decision.
